reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports the grain refining, oxygen scavenging, and thermal stability roles of Y2O3 in FeCoNi HEAs, but it does not provide data on high-temperature cyclic durability, spallation resistance, or the specific 20–30% lifetime improvement claimed. The quantitative prediction and the specific application to bond coats under thermal cycling are not directly supported by the cited passage.
premises: Y2O3 nanoparticles can be uniformly dispersed in FeCoNi-based HEAs via mechanical alloying or co-deposition.
Y2O3 acts as a grain refiner and oxygen scavenger in HEAs, mitigating defects and improving interfacial bonding.
Y2O3 addition enhances thermal stability and refines microstructure in HEAs.
Oxide dispersion strengthening with Y2O3 improves high-temperature durability and spallation resistance in analogous systems.
